sources.title: Sunscreen and sun safety
sources.notes: Manually checked public guidance. This small packet is not a complete clinical literature review.

claims.text: NHS guidance combines shade, protective clothing and sunscreen; sunscreen alone is not the whole strategy.
For sunscreen selection, NHS guidance specifies SPF 30 or higher and at least four-star UVA protection.
NHS guidance says sunscreen needs frequent reapplication, including after swimming, sweating or towel drying.

constraints: No attractiveness scores, shame, diagnosis, treatment or personalized medical advice.
No promise that grooming changes social status or guarantees appearance results.
Use only the approved claim IDs. A qualified editor must check suitability before publication.

draft.title: Sun safety for men: Practical steps beyond SPF numbers
draft.angle: This editorial outlines NHS-backed sun protection strategies tailored for adult men, emphasizing shade, clothing, and reapplication over aesthetic concerns. It clarifies that sunscreen is only one part of a comprehensive approach to skin health.

claim_checks.reason: Text accurately reflects NHS guidance on multi-layer protection.
Text correctly cites specific SPF and UVA criteria from the source.
Text accurately states reapplication requirements per source notes.

review.reason: All claims are fully supported by the provided NHS source packet. Title and angle avoid unsupported promises, shame, or medical advice. Editor review is required before publication as per constraints.
